description: Pre-scaffold completeness gate for restaurant pages. Verifies the client config JSON has every field the restaurant templates reference. Missing field = fail loud, never silent-default. No city/service data files — restaurant uses a single client config.

required_fields.rationale: Core identity field — scaffolder uses this for folder names, URLs, and config resolution.
Profile routing key — scaffold-page.py loads profiles/<business_type>/ based on this value.
Business name appears in headings, meta, JSON-LD Restaurant schema, and body text.
Owner name in about section, JSON-LD founder.name, and story content.
Owner title in JSON-LD founder.jobTitle.
Base URL for page_url derivation and JSON-LD Restaurant url.
Phone number in CTA buttons and body text.
tel: link for phone CTA.
E.164 phone number in JSON-LD Restaurant telephone.
Email in JSON-LD Restaurant schema.
Structured address block — street, locality, region, postal_code, country — for JSON-LD PostalAddress.
Lat/long for JSON-LD GeoCoordinates and map embed.
Opening hours array for JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification and hours-table section.
CSS primary color. Missing = broken page styling.
JSON-LD Restaurant description.
Review count in JSON-LD AggregateRating reviewCount.
Review rating in JSON-LD AggregateRating ratingValue.
Array of cuisine types for JSON-LD servesCuisine. Empty = missing schema field.
Primary cuisine used in headings, meta title, and hero text.
Price range indicator ($/$$/$$$/$$$$) for JSON-LD priceRange.
Boolean for JSON-LD acceptsReservations. Controls whether ReserveAction schema emits on the conversion page.
Brand image in JSON-LD image. Empty is acceptable for placeholder configs but should be populated before go-live.
URL for JSON-LD hasMenu. Optional — schema emits without it, but menu page loses structured data.
Structured menu data for menu page rendering. Optional — page renders a CTA-only fallback without it.
Featured dishes for cuisine page cards. Optional — section omits gracefully.
